US8069128B2.description: A patent document titled "Real-time ad-hoc spam filtering of email" describing a multi-pass ad-hoc spam message filtering approach.

Multi-Pass Ad-Hoc Spam Message Filtering.description: A filtering approach that dynamically generates a temporary classifier during a first pass based on results of a previously applied message filter that sorts messages into folders, then uses the classifier in a second pass to retrospectively inspect messages for misclassification.

Classification Model.description: A model generated during the first pass analysis based on message folder placement and message attributes, used to score and identify misclassified messages; it resides exclusively in non-persistent memory and is purged after use.

First Message Filter.description: A previously applied message filter that sorts messages into a plurality of different message folders and stores first classification data in a persistent store.

Second Multi-Pass Message Filter.description: A filter configured to generate a classification model from a first pass analysis and use it in a second pass to generate misclassification identification of sorted messages.

Network Device.description: A device comprising a transceiver to send and receive data over a network and a processor operative to perform multi-pass message filtering actions.

Transceiver.description: A component of the network device that sends and receives data over a network.

Processor.description: A component of the network device operative to perform actions including first and second pass analysis, displaying misclassification identification, and purging the classification model.

Message Folders.description: A plurality of different folders into which messages are sorted by the first message filter and inspected by the multi-pass filter.

Misclassification Identification.description: A generated identification of sorted messages that might be misclassified, displayed so a user can move misclassified messages to a different folder.

Non-Persistent Memory Location.description: A memory-resident-only location where the generated classification model resides exclusively, not stored on disk or another persistent data store, and from which it is purged.

Persistent Store.description: A persistent data store where the first message filter stores first classification data.

Processor Readable Storage Medium.description: A medium including data and instructions whose execution on a computing device provides for managing messages.

Client Device.description: A user's device on which the classification model is maintained in memory and where the first and second passes may occur entirely.

Sender Information.description: Information within messages read during the first pass, including sender address and whether the sender's address is in an address book associated with a recipient.

Message Headers.description: Header information within messages, including a subject, read during the first pass analysis.

Originating Network Address.description: A network address from which a message originates, read during the first pass analysis.

Message Contents.description: The content of messages read during the first pass analysis.

Attachments.description: Files attached to messages, read during the first pass analysis.

Address Book.description: An address book associated with a recipient that is associated with the message folders, used in analysis of message senders.

Spam.description: Unwanted email messages that the filtering approach aims to identify and filter.
